title: Journal v2: schema-validated, indexed run journals
summary: The journal module is split into five files and grows from a two-payload buffer into a versioned, schema-validated event log. Events now carry an actor, an optional work item and change, and an optional cost; eight payload types replace the original two. Every appended event is validated against a JSON Schema before a byte is written, a run-complete event must name the current head hash and closes the run, and the first accepted event records the run in a per-work-item index guarded by a lock file. The journal directory moves from `buffer/` to `runs/`, and a new reader replays a run's chain, refusing any line that is malformed, schema-invalid, off the chain, or after run-complete.

nodes.label: Checkpoint runner
nodes.subtitle: osf verify --checkpoint
nodes.summary: Runs moon tasks for a checkpoint and writes one verification event per task plus a checkpoint-complete event. Now builds an `Actor::system("osf")` instead of a bare string, and fills the new `check_type`, `summary` and typed `EvidenceGrade` fields.

nodes.label: Journal writer
nodes.subtitle: Journal::append / append_draft
nodes.summary: Opens `<state_dir>/runs/<run>.jsonl`, validates each draft against the event schema, records the run in the work-item index on the first accepted event, and appends one JSON line. A refused event writes nothing and leaves the chain head unchanged; a run-complete event closes the journal to further appends.

nodes.label: Event model
nodes.subtitle: event.rs
nodes.summary: The versioned envelope and its payloads: Actor, Cost, Change, EvidenceGrade, and the eight event types (run-started, verification, review, finding, state-change, run-complete, attention, checkpoint-complete).

nodes.label: Event schema
nodes.subtitle: event.schema.json
nodes.summary: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for one event envelope, with per-event-type payload branches and cross-field rules: a harness actor must name its model, a non-observed finding may not claim `verified_by`, and only a blocked state change may carry a cause.

nodes.label: Schema validator
nodes.subtitle: schema::validate
nodes.summary: Compiles the embedded schema once per process into a `jsonschema::Validator` and returns one reason string per violation, each naming the JSON path.

nodes.label: Hash chain
nodes.subtitle: hash.rs
nodes.summary: Computes the SHA-256 digest over prev_hash, a newline, and the canonical JSON of payload, work_item, change, actor and cost. Verification duration and cache are neutralised; run id, timestamp and schema version are excluded. Two pinned digests lock the layout.

nodes.label: Run index
nodes.subtitle: index.rs
nodes.summary: One JSON file per work item under `<state_dir>/index`, named by the SHA-256 hex of the work item id, listing that work item's run ids in recorded order. Writes go through a temporary file renamed over the target, guarded by a lock file that is waited on and reclaimed when stale.

nodes.label: Journal reader
nodes.subtitle: reader::read_run
nodes.summary: Replays a run's journal, checking every line against the schema and every link against the recomputed hash before returning any event. A broken chain is reported as broken, never as a partial list; a truncated tail reads as incomplete rather than invalid.

nodes.label: runs/
nodes.subtitle: <state_dir>/runs/<run>.jsonl
nodes.summary: The per-run hash-chained journal file, one JSON event per line. Renamed from `buffer/`; the run id is validated as a safe single path component before the path is built.

nodes.label: index/
nodes.subtitle: <state_dir>/index/<sha256>.json
nodes.summary: Per-work-item run lists, plus a `.lock` sibling per index file. Created only when a journal carries a work item.

nodes.label: jsonschema 0.58.5
nodes.subtitle: default-features = false
nodes.summary: New dependency of the osf crate, pulling in referencing, fancy-regex, ahash and friends. Used only by the journal schema validator.

nodes.label: CI checkpoint job
nodes.subtitle: .github/workflows/ci.yml
nodes.summary: The checkpoint-evidence artifact path follows the journal from `$OSF_STATE_DIR/buffer` to `$OSF_STATE_DIR/runs`.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The runner hands each verification and checkpoint-complete payload to the writer, now with an Actor value and the new typed fields.

edges.label: validate(event)
edges.summary: Every draft is serialised and validated before any byte is written; a failure returns the reasons and leaves the file and chain head untouched.

edges.label: include_str!
edges.summary: The schema is embedded in the binary and compiled once into a process-wide validator.
The validator is the only consumer of the new jsonschema dependency.

edges.label: event_hash(HashInput)
edges.summary: The writer builds a HashInput from the draft plus the journal's work item and change, and stores the returned digest as the event's hash.

edges.label: record_run
edges.summary: On the first accepted event of a run that carries a work item, the writer records the run in the index before writing the journal line; a failed index update refuses the event.

edges.label: one JSON line
edges.summary: The validated event is appended as one JSON line with a trailing newline.

edges.label: temp file + rename
edges.summary: The index body is written to a temporary sibling and renamed over the target, so a reader never sees a half-written index.

edges.label: read_to_string
edges.summary: The reader loads the run's journal file and checks it line by line.
Each line is validated against the same schema the writer used before it is accepted.

edges.label: recompute + compare
edges.summary: The reader recomputes each event's hash from its own fields and compares it with the stored hash, and checks prev_hash against the running head.

edges.label: runs_for_work_item
edges.summary: The reader module re-exports the index lookup so a caller can list a work item's runs without scanning the runs directory.

edges.label: artifact upload
edges.summary: The CI checkpoint job uploads the runs directory as evidence instead of the old buffer directory.
